style: Warm, joyful hand-painted storybook illustration in the look of a 2D animated family film: soft painterly brush strokes, rounded friendly shapes, bright autumn and summer colours, warm golden light, gentle shadows, lively and happy, cinematic widescreen composition. The people, the dog and the creatures are always the same, exactly as in their reference sheets, and nobody else unless asked. No text, no letters, no borders.

cast.oskar: Oskar, a little boy of three: short light-blond hair with a side parting, brown eyes, round rosy cheeks, a cheeky expression, a grey quilted zip jacket, dark blue jeans
cast.walter: Walter, Oskar's big brother, about six: tousled very light-blond hair, blue eyes, a huge laughing grin, lilac headphones over his ears, a grey-olive winter parka with a fur-trimmed hood, dark trousers
cast.max: Max, a little boy of four: short light-blond hair, blue eyes, round cheeks, a huge laughing smile, a light blue striped shirt, a grey bandana bib, light green trousers
cast.farmor: Farmor, a cheerful grandmother in her sixties: shoulder-length wavy blond hair, blue eyes, a warm smile, a big grey-and-beige leopard-pattern wool scarf, a long camel-brown padded coat
cast.farfar: Farfar, a jolly grandfather in his sixties: bald on top with short white hair at the sides, a short white beard, blue eyes, a round friendly face, an olive-green hooded jacket, brown felt slippers
cast.chester: Chester, a big friendly golden labrador mix: sandy golden coat, lighter chest, floppy ears, kind brown eyes, a black collar
cast.funky: Funky, a small cheerful storybook troll girl: big round nose, pointy ears, wild bright orange hair in two big puffs, freckles, a lime-green tunic and red-and-white stripy tights, big bare feet, a mischievous grin
cast.flunky: Flunky, a small clumsy storybook troll girl: big round nose, pointy ears, a messy purple hair bun with a twig stuck in it, rosy cheeks, a sky-blue patched dress, big bare feet, always giggling
cast.lonky: Lonky, a tall lanky storybook troll girl: big round nose, pointy ears, long straight moss-green hair, gentle kind eyes, a yellow knitted sweater and brown shorts, big bare feet, calm and friendly
cast.dino: the Dinosaur: a big friendly round-bellied green T-rex in soft cartoon shapes, light-green belly, tiny arms, big happy eyes, a goofy toothy smile, never scary
cast.robot: the Spider Robot: a friendly robot spider the size of a big dog, eight shiny silver metal legs, a round polished silver body, one big round glowing red eye that looks curious and kind, two little antennae; cute, never scary
